verdict.rationale: Quo's own docs show voicemails are transcribed, and the transcripts can be read from an AI chat through Quo's official MCP connectors, so the founder can read them without dialing in. That access is pull-based: the user has to ask an agent for them. Nothing shows transcripts being pushed automatically to email or to a team chat app as each voicemail arrives. Missing for 10: automatic email delivery of voicemail transcripts, push delivery to chat apps such as Slack, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, voicemails are transcribed and delivered to email or chat so I can read them without dialing in

citations.quote: Get info about your missed calls to your Quo numbers, and see their voicemail transcripts directly from your chat.
Retrieve call history and voicemail transcripts from your Quo number.
Connect Quo to any agent and manage your conversations, contacts, and call transcripts in plain English. No coding required.
